question: Can an LLM be tuned to follow instructions in audio, video, 3D and image modalities using only image-text training, by exploiting ImageBind's joint embedding space?
hypothesis: Because ImageBind aligns other modalities to images, image-text-only tuning of LLaMA transfers to audio, video and 3D inputs through their own ImageBind encoders, and a training-free cache of image features reduces the training-inference modality gap.
contributions: Multi-modality instructions (image, text, audio, 3D point clouds, video, embedding-space arithmetic) from image-text-only tuning
Tuning efficiency: ImageBind image encoder frozen; LoRA and bias-norm tuning of LLaMA; only bind network and zero-init gates trained
Attention-free zero-initialized injection of one visual feature added to all word tokens at all layers
Cross-modality cache retrieval to alleviate modality discrepancy between training (image) and inference (multiple modalities)

method.summary: A frozen ImageBind image encoder gives one global feature, a trainable bind network (linear layer plus three RMSNorm/SiLU/residual blocks) maps it to LLaMA width, and the result is multiplied by a zero-initialised gate and added to every word token at all 32 LLaMA layers. Stage 1 pre-trains on 940M image-text pairs; stage 2 tunes LLaMA with LoRA and bias-norm on language and visual instruction data. At inference other modalities go through their ImageBind encoders, optionally enhanced by top-k retrieval from a cache of CC3M ImageBind image features.
method.task: multi-modality instruction tuning (image-conditioned captioning pre-training, then instruction tuning)

evidence.quote: We pre-train the model on 32 A100 GPUs for 3 epochs. The total batch size and learning rate is set to 1024 and 4e-4, respectively. We fine-tune the model on 8 A100 GPUs for 4 epochs The warmup epoch, total batch size, learning rate is set to 1, 32 and 1.25e-4.

results.claim: LLaVA (257 tokens) IIIT5K accuracy, also above ImageBind-LLM.
Authors attribute poor OCR to the single modality token, with no ablation.
results.quote: we discovered that both of them employ only one token for the modality feature, while the other VLMs utilize at least ten tokens for capturing visual information. This disparity may allow other VLM models to better comprehend the visual information depicted in the images.

results.claim: Authors name the single global token as a likely cause of hallucination and plan to add more tokens.
results.quote: ImageBind-LLM only injects one global visual token into LLMs, which is much smaller than other models (10 for LLaMA-Adapter, 32 for MiniGPT4 and 256 for LLaVA).

limits: No ablation of token count, bind network, gate, cache or training stages; the single-token explanation is conjecture (Sec 4.2.2).
Audio, video and 3D evaluated only qualitatively (Figs 5-12).
Cache k, alpha and bind-network hidden dim not stated; LLaMA size not stated; optimizer, schedule, precision, seeds not stated.
Abstract says cache holds three million features, Sec 3.1.3 says 1 million; default is all CC3M images.
Hallucination on descriptive instructions; instruction data not human-verified; modality mixup fragile.
Baseline numbers' provenance (rerun or copied) not stated; the paper says 'at least ten tokens' for other VLMs and LLaVA is 256 in text but 257 in tables.
